note: AD-12 §3.1 mitigation 1, coordinated seed allocation (authorization §6.1). READ-ONLY at runtime and NEVER written by the process: the container has a read-only root filesystem, no volume and no published port (infra/compose.observations.yaml), so a runtime-written ledger is impossible and a reviewed file in source control is the only form the record can take. Changing an allocation is a reviewed commit, which is the audit trail. The env-configured D-24 generator (CBDC_INGESTION_SEED, default 20261125) is EXEMPT and deliberately absent: it is not registry-selected, and an unscoped check would refuse to start the approved D-24 slice.

allocations.intent: The Phase 3.3-A synthetic FX adapter path. Distinct from the D-24 generator's default seed 20261125, which holds no allocation and needs none.
